messages:
elaine: Heads-up 1: I'm opening a small TF change to split GPU nodepools into `reserved` and `spot-burst` resources. Want quick eyes on labels / capacity reservation approach before I push.

toni: Nice. Can you outline the plan? e.g., are we using AWS Capacity Reservations or a pinned on-demand launch template?

elaine: Plan:
1) One ASG for reserved GPUs with capacity_reservation_target and pinned launch template (stable instance types only)
2) One ASG (mixed instances) for spot-burst with fallback to on-demand overrides
3) Node labels: `gpu.pool=reserved|spot`, `gpu.sku=a100|t4` so schedulers can prefer
4) TF module changes scoped to nodepool module, add `capacity_reservation_id` as optional

raj: For TF, prefer a `reserved_pool` boolean flag instead of special-casing in module invocation. Keeps callsites simpler. Also add an output with `launch_template_id` so other stacks can reference it.

elsine: @raj nice. I was thinking of a `reservation_profile` map so we can pass AZ-level reservation ids. But that may be overkill.

toni: What about kube-side: tolerations + node affinity vs topology spread for low-latency endpoints?

elaine: For kube manifests:
- short-lived batch jobs: nodeAffinity prefer spot, toleration not needed
- services/endpoints: hard nodeAffinity -> reserved pool + pod disruption budgets
- example affinity snippet I plan to add to kustomize overlays:
```
nodeAffinity:
  preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
  - weight: 100
    preference:
      matchExpressions:
      - key: gpu.pool
        operator: In
        values: [spot]
```

sam: On preemption handling, I'd recommend a lightweight daemonset that catches instance metadata interruption notice and gracefully annotates the node + adds a `preempting=true` label (so we can alert). Then a controller can cordon/drain respecting PDBs.

raj: Also ensure the node bootstrap can mount AWS Secrets Manager/SSM for driver keys if needed. I've seen cases where ephemeral nodes don't get the right KMS permissions and node GPU drivers fail.

elaine: Good call. TF change will add IAM role policy attachments for the node role when `enable_gpu_drivers_ssm = true`.

toni: Secret wiring question: should we push driver license blobs into a Kubernetes secret and let daemonset consume, or rely on instance role to pull at boot?

sam: Prefer instance role at boot for scale — avoids k8s secret churn and TTLs for thousands of spot nodes. But keep a fallback K8s secret for reserved pool where we have stricter control. Document both flows.

elaine: I'll add both in the module and default to instance-role path. TF var `driver_install_mode = "instance_role|k8s_secret"` with default `instance_role`.

devops-bot: CI plan queued: https://ci.internal/plan/8991 - will run terraform plan against staging.

raj: Autoscaler nuance: set `expander=least-waste` and `balance-similar-node-groups=true` for mixed instance spot pools. Also set `max-node-provision-time` generous for GPU boot time (10m+).

toni: Need to be careful about `create_before_destroy` on launch templates; IG rolling replacements can cause capacity blips in prod AZs. Add `max_unavailable` to k8s rolling strategy.

elaine: I'll add lifecycle.create_before_destroy = true only for reserved pool LT changes where we accept temporary duplicates.

sam: Small addition: label nodes with `gpu.allocated_by=kubernetes` and `redwood.nodepool=<name>` so RBAC and cost tooling can consume them.

elaine: Thanks. Action items:
- I'll open PR with TF changes + README: infra/terraform/modules/nodepool#pr
- @sam please sketch the preempt daemonset (image + detectors for both AWS & GCP)
- @raj review IAM roles + SSM access for driver boot
- @toni check k8s affinity/toleration snippets for prod overlays

infra-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3288 (TF plan attached)

toni: I'll do a pass this afternoon. Quick note: add a test target that spins up one spot and one reserved nodepool in ephemeral env so we can run the bootstrap smoke tests.

sam: Will prototype daemonset and push sample manifests under `manifests/gpu-preempt/`.

elaine: Great. If folks can review by EOD tomorrow I can merge during the 2-4am rollout window. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: deploy-preview: https://preview.redwood-inference.internal/3372 (kustomize overlays included)

elaine: thanks all, closing loop once reviews in.
